column1: H5-ORR1H5-CRD1The Observable Representation shall preserve whether the vehicle's operational motion is consistent with the intended trajectory.TrajectoryConsistent_R(x) != TrajectoryConsistent_R(y) for situations separated by H5-CRD1.H-5;FR-6.1;FR-6.2;FR-6.3Without this distinction the representation cannot support evaluation of whether the vehicle follows the intended trajectory.

H5-ORR2H5-CRD2The Observable Representation shall preserve whether the vehicle's operational motion remains within the applicable road boundaries.WithinRoadBoundaries_R(x) != WithinRoadBoundaries_R(y) for situations separated by H5-CRD2.SG-5;H-5;SR-5.3.2Without this distinction the representation cannot support evaluation of unintended leaving of the road.
